sub_graphs.title: Consensus Specs: Fork Upgrade State Transitions
sub_graphs.description: Models the state transitions of the Ethereum consensus layer through its sequential hard fork upgrades

nodes.label: Phase0 Active (Epoch 0)
nodes.description: Initial proof-of-stake consensus is active with basic beacon chain functionality

nodes.label: Upgrade to Altair
nodes.description: Apply Altair fork at epoch 74240, adding light client support and sync committee mechanisms

nodes.label: Altair Active (Epoch 74240)
nodes.description: Light client support and sync committees are operational

nodes.label: Upgrade to Bellatrix
nodes.description: Apply Bellatrix fork at epoch 144896, integrating the execution layer (The Merge)

nodes.label: Bellatrix Active (Epoch 144896)
nodes.description: Execution layer is integrated; proof-of-work is deprecated

nodes.label: Upgrade to Capella
nodes.description: Apply Capella fork at epoch 194048, enabling staking withdrawals

nodes.label: Upgrade to Deneb
nodes.description: Apply Deneb fork at epoch 269568, adding blob transaction support (EIP-4844)

nodes.label: Deneb Active (Epoch 269568)
nodes.description: Blob transactions and data availability sampling support are active

sub_graphs.title: Consensus Specs: Specification Validation via Executable Tests
sub_graphs.description: Models how the consensus specifications are validated through executable Python reference implementations that generate test vectors

nodes.label: Specification Written in Python
nodes.description: Consensus spec is defined as executable Python code that serves as the reference implementation

nodes.label: Generate Test Vectors
nodes.description: Execute the Python reference implementation to produce test vectors for client implementations

nodes.label: Test Vectors Available
nodes.description: Test vectors in standardized format are available for client teams to validate their implementations

nodes.label: Client Implementation Runs Tests
nodes.description: Client implementations execute test vectors to verify conformance with the specification

nodes.label: Client Implementation Conformant
nodes.description: Client passes all test vectors, confirming specification conformance

nodes.label: Client Implementation Non-Conformant
nodes.description: Client fails test vectors, indicating implementation bugs or spec misinterpretation

edges.label: Execute Python spec to generate test vectors

ambiguities.text: The repository overview does not specify the exact relationship between the Gloas in-development fork and the currently active Fulu fork.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume Gloas is the next planned fork after Fulu, following the sequential upgrade pattern, with a TBD activation epoch.

implicit_assumptions.description: All client implementations are assumed to correctly implement the specification as defined by the Python reference implementation.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Divergent implementations across clients could cause consensus failures, chain splits, or exploitable inconsistencies at fork boundaries.

implicit_assumptions.description: Fork upgrades are assumed to be coordinated across all clients and activated at the same epoch.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Uncoordinated or partial upgrades could cause chain splits between upgraded and non-upgraded nodes.
